neighbours.label: ' keep' in 'food or drink to keep you going': refreshments described as sustaining someone through a stretch of time
fire: The bakery packs muffins and iced tea in every hamper to keep you going on the long drive.
Hikers should carry trail mix and plenty of water to keep them going until they reach the summit.
At the festival there are food trucks and cold drinks to keep everyone going late into the night.
The hotel leaves fresh fruit and pastries in the lounge to keep guests going between meals.
Bring sandwiches and a thermos of coffee to keep you going during the match.
The canteen serves hearty soups and bread to keep the workers going through the night shift.
Pack energy bars and juice boxes to keep the kids going on the train.
Our spa menu offers smoothies and light salads to keep you going from morning to evening.
